description: This file defines the TimezoneName class, which extends AbstractRule. It provides validation logic to check if a given string is a valid timezone name by attempting to instantiate a DateTimeZone object with it.

classes.name: TimezoneName
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input string is a valid timezone name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a string and a valid timezone name.

methods.name: isValidTimezone
methods.description: Checks if the provided timezone name is valid by attempting to create a DateTimeZone object.
